title: DsDm: Model-Aware Dataset Selection with Datamodels

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 论文先把最优集合定义为固定 learner 与目标分布下、包含训练随机性的期望目标损失最小化，再用线性 datamodel/TRAK 近似每个候选的固定效应。

LIMITATIONS.pages: 1-36 including main discussion, compute appendix and experimental appendices
LIMITATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 全文没有独立局限章节；线性可加假设、四 reference model 充分性、selected arms 的 seed 分布、固定 token 与重复次数混杂及核心选择代码缺失需由审阅边界单独登记。

formulas: For learner A, target distribution D_targ, candidate universe S and size k, the task-optimal set minimizes expected target loss L_D(S)=E_{x~D,A-randomness}[ell(x;A(S))].
A linear datamodel approximates target-example trained loss as tau_theta_x(1_S)=theta_x-transpose 1_S, assigning each candidate a fixed additive coefficient independent of the rest of the set.
Averaging target-specific coefficient vectors reduces the estimated size-k objective to choosing the bottom-k entries of (1/n) sum_x theta_x.
The paper estimates coefficients with four-model projected-gradient TRAK using dimension 16,384; this adds local-linearization, projection, fixed-effect, and ensemble approximations.
algorithm_steps: Freeze an exact candidate corpus, learner, subset size, target distribution, and disjoint target versus holdout identities.
Train four 125M reference language models on random 38% candidate subsets for 80,000 batches each.
For every candidate and target item, compute projected gradients and model-specific TRAK terms, then average across reference models.
Average target-item datamodel coefficients and select the lowest predicted-loss candidates for the requested prefix size.
Train downstream models with a fixed total token budget, changing passes over the selected prefix, and evaluate only on holdout tasks; also train inverse-ranked and random controls.
variables: candidate corpus S, selected subset S-prime, size k, learner A, and learner randomness
target distribution D_targ, target identities, holdout identities, loss ell, and expected trained loss
linear coefficient theta_x, inclusion vector 1_S, TRAK projected gradient, Q term, projection dimension d, and reference model m
selection fraction, unique 1024-token chunks, epochs/passes, fixed token budget, and downstream optimizer steps
target loss or accuracy, broad benchmark accuracy, random-run range, inverse-selection result, FBP compute, and score sign convention
selection_timing: Selection is offline before downstream training, conditioned on a fixed 125M proxy learner and explicit target distribution; it is not refreshed as the downstream model changes.
refresh_rule: A new target mixture, proxy/reference ensemble, candidate corpus, projection, learner, or selection size creates a new ranking; no epoch-lagged dynamic replay refresh is defined.

budget.unit: unique 1024-token candidate chunks selected into a training prefix
budget.unique_sample_definition: Prefix size fixes unique chunks, while the paper does not impose source/domain redundancy constraints beyond candidate preprocessing.
budget.repeat_definition: All models consume a fixed total token budget, so smaller prefixes are traversed more epochs and individual chunks repeat more often.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Total downstream tokens are fixed, but unique IDs, per-ID repetitions, selection fraction and epochs change together; this deliberately couples selection quality with concentration.
budget.compute_cost: Datamodel estimation costs about 1.2e9 forward-backward-pass units; projected-gradient collection across four models contributes roughly 73%, and each reference-model training roughly 7%.

random_baselines: uniform random candidate selection at matched downstream token budget
ten one-epoch random models shown as a performance range in targeted experiments
Inverse-DsDm selecting the least preferred examples
larger random-data models trained with approximately 10x or 2x comparison compute

counts: 4 independently trained reference models for the datamodel estimator
10 random downstream models defining the shaded random range in targeted plots
seed_count.aggregation: selected methods are generally shown as single curves or points rather than matched ten-seed distributions, so treatment sign stability and worst seed are not established.

checkpoint_selection: Target identities select data and disjoint holdout identities evaluate it. Some 125M training settings were selected using held-out C4 perplexity, and broad target mixtures are study choices; no blind-test-driven selection is justified for Stage1.

results.claim: 固定下游 token budget 时，DsDm 在四个目标任务上比 similarity baselines 更稳定，并匹配高计算 random comparator。
results.value: The paper reports DsDm consistently improving target performance and matching a 1.3B random-data model trained with more than 10x compute; ten one-epoch Random models define the shaded range.

ablations: DsDm, uniform Random, Classifier, DSIR, SemDeDup, and Inverse-DsDm
four separate target tasks and a three-target mixture
selection fraction with fixed downstream token budget and changing epochs
negative_results: Classifier and DSIR fail to consistently beat Random on SQuAD and CS-Algorithms.
Single-target selection can reduce performance on unrelated benchmark categories.
Inverse-DsDm prefixes train much worse models than random despite appearing QA-related.
Selected arms lack a matched ten-seed downstream distribution and worst-seed report.
Four reference models and projection dimension 16,384 are unablated implementation choices.
The public repository audited in the inherited review omits the core end-to-end selection implementation.
failure_conditions: The linear fixed-effect datamodel misses candidate interactions, redundancy, or a state-dependent sign reversal.
Target and holdout identities overlap candidate text or blind evaluation leaks into ranking decisions.
A proxy-language-model ranking fails to transfer to the downstream learner or checkpoint state.
Fixed total exposure hides severe per-ID repeat concentration as the prefix becomes smaller.
A target mixture improves its mean while harming a protected role or worst seed.
Projection, tensor sign convention, candidate order, reference seeds, or score artifacts are not hash bound.
limitations: DsDm performs offline pretraining-data selection, not additive replay during a fixed base-training trajectory.
Linear datamodels assume additive fixed effects and omit set interactions and dynamic checkpoint dependence.
Fixed tokens couple selection size, unique identities, repetition, epochs, and optimizer-visible concentration.
Selected arms do not report matched cross-seed distributions, sign agreement, or worst-seed treatment effects.
Estimator computation is enormous and core projected-gradient/selection implementation was unavailable in the inherited repository audit.
No endpoint is an FN=0..95 frontier or dual FN95/TN safety constraint.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文支持把 A 定义为固定 learner、checkpoint 与独立 target role 条件下的方向，并用真正训练的 random 与 inverse controls 反证分数方向；它还要求 target/holdout 身份分离，以及 unique、repeat、selection fraction、累计曝光和 steps 分列。normal-tail 与 weak-defect target 必须先分开，不能混成加权向量。
stage1_non_inference_zh: DsDm 的语言模型结果不能证明 Stage1 replay utility：它是离线 prefix 选择，固定 token 时同时改变 unique 和重复次数，线性 datamodel 不含集合冗余或 checkpoint 状态。它没有严格 R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay、固定基础流、FN95 目标或未见 training seed 配对；四模型/16384 维也不是可移植常数。
exclusion_reason: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON:eligible as target-conditioned selection, inverse-control, and exposure-concentration evidence
